name: Sri Lakshmi Saraswathi Textiles (Arni) Limited
about: Sri Lakshmi Saraswathi Textiles (Arni) Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of yarns in India. The company offers cotton, polyester cotton, and open-end yarns, as well as surgical face masks. Its products are used to manufacture woven and knitted fabrics. The company also exports its products to Belgium, France, Finland, Germany, Italy, Portugal, Spain, Switzerland, Hong Kong, the Czech Republic, the United States, Bahrain, Cyprus, Morocco, and internationally. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Chennai, India.
